D-H63-1.root_cause: hermes serve loads plugins but never runs the agent's tool setup, so tools.registry has no web_search handler there. ctx.dispatch_tool('web_search', ...) returns the registry body {"error": "Unknown tool: web_search"}. coursebook.research.HermesToolSearch only treated {"success": false, ...} as failure, so that body was read as a successful empty search: queries with result_count 0 and no error, and run_research ended at status 'unavailable' with reason 'no source could be fetched' (the exact topic4 evidence).
fix: research._tool_error() treats the registry error body (error set, no data/results) as a real failure, so the ledger records the reason instead of an empty result set.

research.ensure_host_tools() imports the host's own tools.web_tools in the serving process, registering the same web_search/web_extract handlers the agent would dispatch; HermesToolSearch._dispatch retries once after it.
No provider key is read by the plugin and no source is invented: a host that cannot provide the tools still records the unknown-tool failure.

probe.process: in-process plugin discovery (discover_plugins) with the isolated home, same surface hermes serve uses
probe.after: seam rows: 3 (real web results); fetched chars: 3200

D-H63-2.root_cause: The provider enforces JSON-schema maxLength by cutting the value. The plan prompts asked for prose without naming a length, so learner_outcome/evidence_note/parent.reading_level landed exactly on their caps with mid-word/mid-codepoint endings and the independent validator rejected the plans.
fix: Both plan prompts now state bounded lengths below the caps (learner_outcome <=450, evidence_note <=300, time_estimate.rationale <=450, parent.reading_level <=30, parent.parent_facing_summary <=450).

generation._prose_cap_reasons() walks the document's own schema and refuses any prose value at its maxLength before the validator is called; the reason carries the field path and the safe bound into the retry instruction.
A second attempt still at cap is stored as needs_review/reject, never drafted.
